subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should OpenClaw persist the unresumable restart-recovery notice as a durable transcript row for WebChat/non-deliverable sessions?
rationale: The code path is a targeted bug fix, but it creates a new durable transcript artifact for an internal channel and current docs distinguish durable model transcript from live WebChat delivery projection.

options.title: Accept after rebase
options.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve the current transcript/session guards, and land the scoped persistent WebChat notice as the interim fix for the blank failed-session UX.

options.title: Defer to broader recovery UX
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of the broader recover-and-confirm direction if maintainers do not want another transcript artifact for failed turns.

options.title: Wait for SQLite route work
options.body: Hold this PR behind the broader restart-recovery delivery-route storage work if maintainers want one storage model change to own the contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve the current transcript/session guards, and land the scoped persistent WebChat notice as the interim fix for the blank failed-session UX.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior notice path and own the adjacent SQLite restart-recovery route work, making them the clearest decision owner for the durable transcript contract.
